identification: Cyclops (Cyclops & Lines Bros, Australia) Army Jeep pedal car, pressed steel Willys-style jeep, c1955-1965. Olive green, original unrestored paint with heavy surface rust. Bonnet stencil reads '1351507-A' (faint; matches the hood number on reproduction Cyclops Army Jeep decal sets sold on eBay AU), white stars on the body, 'US' with a cartoon helmeted GI head decal and 'M / NC 554' on both sides. Fold-down windscreen frame (no glass/perspex, typical), slotted grille with two headlight bosses, front bumper, rear grab handle, red rear reflector, white pressed-steel wheels with chrome hubcaps and rubber tyres, white steering wheel. Pedal crank and pedals appear present. Lines Bros (Tri-ang) owned Cyclops from 1955, and the body is the Australian cousin of the Tri-ang Willys jeep pedal car. Lot estimate A$350-500.
